snippet.title: 007 First Light - Aston Martin Valhalla Reveal | Xbox Partner Preview 2025
snippet.description:
A Double 0 agent needs the fastest, most dynamic, and the most striking car when they are
on duty.

Meet the Aston Martin Valhalla. A hybrid twin-turbo V8 with over 1000 horsepower and a
few modifications you won't find in the brochure.

To drive this, Bond will have to #EarnTheNumber in #007FirstLight.

007 First Light comes to Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC on March 27th, 2026 as an Xbox Play Anywhere title.

Pre-order now and get a free Deluxe Edition Upgrade: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/007-first-light/9PJ34M93ZV7Z/0017
